view_frame: The drawing provides a TOP view (XY plane) and a FRONT view (XZ plane). The world coordinate system is defined with X as width (left to right), Y as depth (bottom to top in the TOP view), and Z as height/thickness (bottom to top in the FRONT view). The origin (0,0,0) is at the bottom-left corner of the plate's front face.

features.section: Closed XY profile with straight edges, one arc, and one rectangular notch
features.evidence: TOP view shows the outline with dimensions 60 (width) and 40 (height). Notch is 20 wide x 10 deep, centered on top edge. Top-right corner is R6. FRONT view shows thickness 6 and states 'Same outline through full thickness'.

features.placement: Center at (12, 15) in XY plane. Axis is parallel to Z. Extends from Z=0 to Z=6.
features.evidence: TOP view shows a circle labeled 'Ø8 THROUGH'. Text notes specify 'Hole centre: 12 from left edge, 15 from bottom edge'.

connections: The through_hole is subtracted from the plate_body.
The notch is part of the plate_body profile definition.
edit_rules: Changing the plate width (60) or height (40) requires updating the profile vertices and the arc center/radius if the corner is affected.
Changing the notch width (20) or depth (10) requires updating the notch vertices in the profile.
Changing the hole diameter (Ø8) updates the cylinder radius.
Changing the hole position updates the cylinder center coordinates.
Changing the thickness (6) updates the extrusion length of the plate_body and the height of the through_hole.
